frames.monsters: 20 distinct forms; 4 walk + 4 attack + 4 hit reaction + 4 death each

production.normalization: Whole connected alpha silhouettes; one scale across actor poses, one scale per wind phase; clear low-alpha RGB; at least 10px output gutters.
production.background: Five authored landscapes normalized to 900x1600, original castle foreground composited with approach-only fade at y920–1000 to preserve tower/platform geometry.

sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the existing fortress battlefield; edit only its terrain and distant landscape for a new campaign stage. Keep camera and portrait 9:16 composition. Theme: emerald thorn forest at dusk, knotted giant trees along the sides, mossy earth, pale green mist. The huge open central battle route must remain completely unobstructed, low contrast ground from y=15% to y=67%, details only at edges. Preserve EXACT bottom third fortress: four identical evenly spaced tower decks at x=16.7%,38.9%,61.1%,83.3%, standing floors y=71%, front wall y=68%, blue banners and central lower archer platform at x50%,y89.5%. No people or monsters, no UI/text. Hand-painted polished 2.5D fantasy game background matching reference. Keep fortress shape and positions unchanged; change surrounding atmosphere, terrain and sky.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production animated monster spritesheet for a polished Vietnamese fantasy tower defense game. Hand-painted detailed 2.5D game art, crisp dark silhouette edges, rich shaded materials, readable at 64px. SAME character design, costume, proportions and camera in every frame. Slight overhead three-quarter FRONT view, character faces SOUTH toward viewer and walks toward bottom. Actual transparent alpha background. EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 separate frames evenly spaced on a square canvas. Every complete silhouette including all weapons, tails, particles and feet stays inside middle 70% of its cell; wide empty transparent gutters. No cropping, no cell touching, no borders, no labels, no text, no ground tiles or scenery. Row 1: four different walking cycle poses with alternating legs. Row 2: four distinct anticipation, windup, strike, follow-through attack poses toward viewer. Row 3: four hit-reaction recoil/recovery poses. Row 4: four progressive dying/collapse poses, final body lying on ground. Do not repeat the same pose; all 16 complete frames required. Stable body scale and foot baseline within each row. Subject: a thorn-armored twig goblin with a hooked wooden blade, small nimble humanoid, moss green and bark brown.
